text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, or perhaps the Breeders' Cup...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Both are equally wonderful,
and both are exceptionally harsh ordeals—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (...Whichever path I see through to the end, I should be able to reach "that place." Well then—)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I wonder which one I should challenge...?

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're aiming for overseas races?!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But I had absolutely no idea how to go about gathering info~.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
"Why not ask a senior for advice?
I heard Journey-senpai knows a lot about it.
You know, that Expedition Whatever Committee!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Dream Journey...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying she had business with Dream Journey,
Red Desire dragged me along to
the Expedition Support Committee.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: So... what did you want to consult me about specifically?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey is the chairwoman of the Expedition Support Committee,
which handles logistics for overseas trips, and is an exceedingly polite, soft-spoken Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, she is also a powerhouse who has triumphed in numerous graded stakes, including the Takarazuka Kinen and the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: (Talented in so many areas... a truly outstanding individual.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I want you to discern it with your own eyes.
The path that truly leads to an isekai—!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I explained that Red Desire is looking to challenge an overseas race, and is torn between the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe and the Breeders' Cup.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see...
...What did you mean earlier when you mentioned an "alternate world"?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "It is a place where Saint Red Desire must reach without fail."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A world that unfolds once you overcome
countless trials and seize the radiant light.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Last year, I ran through the Triple Tiara
and succeeded in gathering radiance, but...
it was not enough to reach the Otherworld.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"So this year, whether it be the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe' or the 'Breeders' Cup',
I wish to challenge those great overseas races
and seize even greater brilliance!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You have one too, don't you?
An exquisite... unreachable dream.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am fully aware of how harsh a path it is.
However... no matter how thorny the road may be, my legs will not stop.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, would you share your wisdom with me?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Understood. That dreamlike journey of yours... please, allow me to assist you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me, Journey-san.
Where is it that I truly ought to run—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —How about the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I will be running as well. So...
would you show me your running?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
In a sense, my judgment at the Osaka Hai... Yes,
I understand completely. I shall brace myself and take on the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"However... please do not forget.
I am merely here to assist."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The final decision
rests in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Truly, Journey-san is a person of profound wisdom.
I am so glad I consulted you."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: However, I cannot simply rejoice. The next race is the Osaka Hai. If I turn in a mediocre run that fails to catch that person's eye...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Forget getting advice—they might just abandon me, judging that I'm not even worth supporting for an overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I must brace myself.
And... I will surely take that leap onto the world stage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the Osaka Hai—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Have you seen Vodka?
choice_data_list: No, I didn't see it, though... Is something wrong?
No, I didn't see it... Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No...
They said they would come to cheer me on,
but I couldn't see them anywhere, so...
choice_data_list: Maybe they'll be running a bit late.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes... Indeed it is.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Right now, I must pour my heart and soul into this.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I only have one thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
All I must do is run with all my might
through this race where judgment before the world is passed—!
